hints.tr: Haritadaki $1$ cm gerçekte $50\,000$ cm. $1$ km $= 100\,000$ cm.
hints.en: $1$ cm on the map is $50\,000$ cm in reality. $1$ km $= 100\,000$ cm.

hints.tr: İkinci soruda önce $12$ km'yi cm'ye çevir, sonra $50\,000$'e böl.
hints.en: In the second question, first convert $12$ km to cm, then divide by $50\,000$.

title.en: Multiplying and dividing by the scale
